name: Shredoka: Magical Girl Skateboarding
summary:
to a dark and dreamy skateparkvania inside the mind of your best friend airkemi, using the power of your skateboard.

inspired by madoka magica, skate story, and pseudoregalia (again)

through 4 areas of the mind: the palace of despair, sea of sadness, pit of mistakes, and the tower of doubt. find the 4 sparks that will reignite airkemi's heart at the tower.

to do that, you'll need all 8 tricks: the blazing kickflip, winding tailgrab, breaking shoveit, anti-melongrab, impossible moonlight, piercing nosegrab, shining laserflip, and the steezing indygrab.

along the way you'll get 4 movement abilities: the board of retribution, trucks of perseverance, wheels of introspection, and the grip tape of determination.

airkemi's negative thoughts. one of them on their own is light work, but together they can pose a thread by combining their roles.

sorrows shoot a straight laser at you from long range, mistakes charge at you but are slow to turn, and regrets try to sabotage where you're going to be.
